summary: Surf Air Mobility Inc. filed an 8-K regarding an exchange of its existing $74M Senior Secured Convertible Note due 2028 (outstanding principal ~$46.9M) for two new notes: a $16.9M New Convertible Note due 2027 and a $30M New Term Note due 2028, with the lender. The New Term Note accrues interest at 12% p.a. beginning 2027. Conversion price is ~$1.116/share. The New Convertible Note allows monthly partial redemptions starting August 2026, either in cash ($2M) or stock (up to 6% of daily volume, capped at $3M), reducing principal at 110%. This recapitalization restructures debt terms. Watch for dilution from conversion and monthly stock redemptions affecting share price.
